exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.

favorable_scene_effect.qualitative: removes travel-time misses and travel delay; realized gain should be largest against fast lateral targets

rules.text: Projectiles become instantaneous hitscan traces with otherwise unchanged range and cadence.
The branch removes travel-time misses and travel delay; its realized gain should be largest against fast lateral targets even though ideal stationary-target DPS is unchanged.
